characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Weapon Master and its Armour value is set to 2.
At the start of each Round of Combat that the model is fighting, if the model is within 12" of one or more friendly models that are equipped with a Great Weapon, Paired Weapons, and/or Shield, the Giant model part gains the corresponding equipment, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text: The wielder gains 3 additional Standard Melee Attacks, whose Strength is always 5 and Armour Penetration always 2.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Immediately before choosing a unit to join using the Hidden rule, the model may gain a Beastie mount without any upgrade for free. If the model joins a unit with at least one Rank-and-File model with Creepy-Crawlies, its mount also gains Creepy-Crawlies.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Stomp Attack (D3+1), and its base size is changed to 75×100 mm.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
The model part gains +1 Att while another friendly unit is Engaged in Combat anywhere on the Battlefield.
Only units containing a Rank-and-File model can benefit from this rule.
Note: when Engaged in Combat, units without a Rank-and-File model still counts as a unit Engaged in Combat for other units.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model’s Armour value is set to 3, and it gains Strider (Ruins).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Hard Target (1), Light Troops, Scout, Skirmisher, and Strider.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
The model can never benefit from Parry.
After the First Round of Combat, all of the model parts’ Melee Weapons count as a Hand Weapon for all rules purposes, with Duration: End of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If the General is a Darrmu, apply the following changes to Army List creation:
  • Max. 10% of the Army Points may be spent on units entirely with Orc.
  • The Rarity and Duplication Limits Max. X items/army (i.e. max. X units/army, Max. X per Warband, and ) in the unit profiles of certain units entirely with Goblin are modified, as indicated by D X.
For example, Uncommon (D Regular) means that if the General is a Darrmu, the Rarity becomes Regular, whereas max. 1 (D 2) units/army means that if the General is a Darrmu, the Duplication Limit becomes max. 2 units/army.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Fly, Hard Target (1), Light Troops, and Skirmisher.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A Charging model with this Attribute, or using a weapon with this Attribute, gains the Model Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets (X). For example, a Charging model part with Devastating Charge (+1 Strength, Poison Attacks) gains +1 Strength and Poison Attacks when it is Charging. This rule is cumulative: a model part with several instances of Devastating Charge applies all Attack Attributes and Characteristics modifiers from all of them when Charging.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Extra Support replaces the limit on the maximum number of attacks the model can do as Restricted Attack with the value in brackets (X) or, if it includes a +, increases that limit with +X.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
Charges cannot be declared against the model with Force of Destruction.
This model is ignored by other units and ignores them for the purpose of Unit Spacing. It may come into contact and move through other units, and other units may come into contact and move through it (excluding Ambush).
When model with Force of Destruction comes into contact with another unit, the other unit immediately suffers X hits with the model’s Strength and Armour Penetration, and the model with Force of Destruction is immediately removed as a casualty.
If several units come into contact simultaneously the model with Force of Destruction chooses which unit suffers the hits.
If the model was removed due to another unit moving into contact with it, that unit suffers an additional D6 hits. Health Point losses caused by Force of Destruction in the Charge Phase do not cause Panic Test.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Unruly and Orc. In addition, the Giant model part gains Brood Rivalry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
A unit hit by a Git Launcher suffers 2D6 hits with Str 4 and AP 2.
On a to-hit roll of ‘6’, you may instead place a Mad Git within 3" of the target and more than 1" away from any Impassable Terrain and other units, following the rules for Summoned Units.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only Duration: End of Turn.
Friendly Gnasher and Gnasher Dasher units within 18" gain Frenzy, and their Charge Range rolls are Maximised. Model parts with Gnasher gain Fury.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Immediately before taking a Courage Test, that is not automatically passed, any unit consisting entirely of models with Goblin Cunning may choose to fail the Courage Test instead of rolling it.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Duration: Permanent.
During Pre-game Selections, you may choose any Terrain (X) from: Field, Forest, Ruins, or Water Terrain.
All Terrain Features following the rules for X are Dangerous Terrain (6+) instead of any other instance of Dangerous Terrain.
In addition, friendly models with Goblin gain Strider (X).

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
One use only.
May be activated at the start of any phase, or during Choosing Equipment and Abilities: the bearer’s unit gains Dying Blow, Fearless, and Unstable, with Duration: End of Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: To-wound rolls of ‘1’ with Melee Attacks from friendly units within 8" must be rerolled.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
A model part with Grind Attack resolves these attacks at the same Initiative Step as its Close Combat Attacks. It must choose an enemy model in base contact with it. The chosen enemy model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Can be cast in one of two versions:
Augment: cannot be cast by a Goblin.
The target gains +1 to hit, and its Charge Range, Flee Distance, and Pursuit Distance are increased by 1".

Hex: cannot be cast by an Orc. The target suffers −1 to hit, and its Charge Range, Flee Distance, and Pursuit Distance are reduced by 1".

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Legendary.
Units containing Headbashers gain Bodyguard (Tribe Leader), and Rank-and-File model parts with Orc in the unit gain Lethal Strike.
Additionally, units entirely with Headbashers that count towards Core count towards Special instead.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part with Goblin gains March and Shoot, Poison Attacks (Melee and Shooting), and gains Throwing Weapons (4+) with Shots 3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Creepy-Crawlies, and its base size is changed to 50×50 mm.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: HP set to 8, base size changed to 100×150 mm, and number of Rider model parts set to 8.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
At Initiative Step 10, a Charging model part with Impact Hits must choose an enemy model in base contact. This model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the attacking model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If equipped with a Flail, this Skill can be activated during the model’s End of Status Phase, unless the model is Engaged in Combat, Knocked Down, Dazed or Mounted. When activated, apply the following to the model until the end of the game:
  • Changes its Base Size to 25mm round.
  • Gains +D6 Attack Value (roll each time before attacking), Fearless, Hard Target (1), and Random Movement (2D6").
  • Defensive Skill is set to 1.
  • Cannot use any weapon other than its Flail.
  • Cannot become Knocked Down or Dazed.
  • Cannot perform Shooting Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part with Goblin gains First Strike (Hatred), Fury, and gains a Great Weapon.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The bearer can cast Totemic Summon (Shamanism) as a Bound Spell (6+).

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: End of Turn
Cannot be activated at the same turn as War Cry!.
The bearer’s unit gains the effects of War Cry! as if the General had used it this turn.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+X Att, +X Str, and +X AP.
X is equal to the number of friendly units containing Orc that are Engaged in Combat anywhere on the Battlefield, up to a maximum of +3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Fearless.
Units entirely with Orc do not cause Panic Test on units entirely with Orc when making Flee Moves through them.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model’s base size is changed to 60×60 mm.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
During the Siphon the Veil step of your Magic Phase, the wearer may gain Channel (D3), with Duration: One Phase.
If a ‘3’ is rolled for this, all units within 6" of the wearer suffer the Witchfire Miscast effect, as if 5 dice had been used.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Stomp Attack can make a Special Attack which is resolved at Agility Step 0, can only be allocated towards a Health Pool of Height 0–1, and inflicts X hits, using the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons. If more than one model part of a combined model has Stomp Attack, only a single model part (chosen by the model’s owner) can perform its Stomp Attack in each Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model cannot be Deployed normally.
Instead, at the start of any Player Turn, the owner can choose a friendly non-Shaken Unengaged unit of Goblin Rabble or Gogtuk Neophytes:
Deploy the model with Surprise within 3" of the chosen unit and more than 1" away from any Impassable Terrain and away from other units.
If the model is not Deployed by the end of Game Turn 4, it is removed as a casualty.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text: The bearer's model gains +1 HP, and Resilience is set to 6.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If the General is a Tribe Leader, apply the following changes to Army List creation:
  • Max. 10% of the Army Points may be spent on units entirely with Goblin.
  • The Rarity and Duplication Limits Max. X items/army (i.e. max. X units/army, Max. X per Warband, and ) in the unit profiles of certain units entirely with Orc are modified, as indicated by TL X.
For example, Uncommon (TL Regular) means that if the General is a Tribe Leader, the Rarity becomes Regular, whereas max. 1 (TL 2) units/army means that if the General is a Tribe Leader, the Duplication Limit becomes max. 2 units/army.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
Mobility set to 6".
The model’s base size is changed to 40×40 mm, the model gains Troll and its Height is set to 3.
(The model’s base size change cannot be ignored).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Each time a model with Troll Toll loses a health point after failling a Regeneration Save against an enemy Melee Attack, the model part with Troll Toll may immediately perform a Standard Melee Attack towards the Health Pool of the model that caused the wound.
This attack is resolved at the end of the same Agility Step, before any casualties are removed, and does not count against the number of attacks the model with Troll Toll can make due to Restricted Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Each unit can only be chosen up to three times per Player Turn for the Deployment of models with Hidden or Surprise.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One use only.
May be activated at the start of any friendly Player Turn, provided the General is on the Battlefield and not Shaken: apply the following effects, with Duration: One Turn.
  • Friendly units gain +1" Charge Speed and +1" Mobility.
  • If the General is a Goblin Demagogue or a Goblin Witch, friendly units entirely with Goblin gain Light Troops as long as they are not Engaged in Combat.
  • If the General is an Orc Warlord or an Orc Shaman, friendly units entirely with Orc have their Charge Range rolls Maximised.
